purpose: Sub-job of j007 (proximity-boosted BC-mixing screen) on hopper-kinematic-legjnt-medium. Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004/j005/j006 metric)
rule.strong_control: per task, the group among T, BC, BCMIX with the highest Last5 mean over seeds 3111-3115
rule.screen_effective: candidate minus strong control, paired by seed: mean > 0 and mean > 1 * paired SE
rule.supported: screen-effective on at least 2 of the 3 tasks (j007a/b/c combined) -> a confirmation job with 5 never-used seeds per task on those tasks
rule.rejected: paired mean difference <= 0 on at least 2 of the 3 tasks
rule.descriptive: 2 * SE criterion, candidate minus BCMIX / BC / T, PB50 vs PB25, near-set size, near-row BC loss, episode lengths
rule.note: Rules are fixed before results; not changed after results are seen. The verdict is made only after all three sub-jobs finish; if any sub-job fails, no verdict.

candidate_settings.near_set: source rows with standardized-state nearest distance to target states <= tau; tau = 90% quantile of target leave-one-trajectory-out nearest distances (exactly the rows j005 CG90 removed)
candidate_settings.loss: mean BC loss over 64 target rows + mean BC loss over the 64 source rows (same as BCMIX)
